regime_context: China A-shares show a single eligible trend theme (Banks) but the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold historically here (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape). Rotation is narrow (1/22 eligible) and non-directional; overall verdict is 'discipline_not_prediction', so any leans must be low-conviction conditionals.

I would retire the idea that a handoff is forming only if Gold Miners' breadth rises above ~0.4 while Banks' durability bar falls below 0.6 over the next two weeks.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with the highest durability bar (0.75) and broad breadth (0.611), which the detector flags as trend-health and cohesion — but this is a FOCUS lens, not alpha. Given gate_helps=false, the trend discipline did not cut drawdown on A-shares history, so any trend lean here is explicitly an experimental expression of my judgement, not a detector prediction. I prefer the strongest-durability, broad-breadth theme only if price confirms; I will not size into it on the rank alone.
evidence: gate_helps=false (abs-trend gate did NOT hold here — mean-revert tape whipsaws)
crowded=true, crowding_z=1.6 (size-down caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: The A-shares tape mean-reverts; a crowded, high-durability trend leader in a market where the trend gate has no drawdown-reduction history is exactly the setup that whipsaws — Banks leadership can reverse without warning.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is mean-reverting with poor durability (0.23) and middling breadth (0.30), ranked only 4th — not a trend leader. In a mean-reverting market where the trend gate does not help, a mean-revert-tagged theme with weak durability is a reasonable avoid/underweight relative to the eligible Banks leader. This is a directional expression of my judgement about the mean-reverting regime, not momentum alpha.
evidence: gate_helps=false implies mean-reverting tape favors avoiding toppy trend-weak themes
theses.dissent: Coal can get a sharp one-off policy or supply squeeze in China regardless of trend-health; ranking near the top-third despite mean-revert tag could still deliver short-term bounce.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
